summary: The LanguageSwitcher is part of the HSPnet.UserControls namespace and is designed to toggle the language setting for a user session in a web application.
purpose: To switch between different locale settings in a user's session by modifying the URL's locale parameter and redirecting the user accordingly.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: Holds session-related information including the current locale.

fields.name: lbLanguageSwitcher
fields.description: A UI control that triggers the language switching process.

workflows.name: Language Switch
steps: The current URL and query parameters are retrieved.
Checks if the Locale parameter is present; if not, adds it using the current session locale.
Toggles the locale parameter to the opposite value.
If the page requested is not 'DEFAULT', hashes the URL.
Redirects the user to the modified URL.

business_rules: Locale parameter must be present in the URL query string.
validations: Check if the Locale parameter is blank and add current locale if necessary.
system_behavior: Redirects the user to a new URL based on locale settings.
dependencies: Relies on HSPnetSession to determine current and alternate locales.
Utilizes Hashing utility for URL modification.
